Note on this copy
---------------------------------------------------------------------

OFL 1.1 clause 2 permits redistribution bundled with software provided
each copy carries the copyright notice and the licence, and states that
these "can be standalone text files, readable headers, or easily viewed
metadata". The .ttf in this directory is byte-for-byte the upstream
release with its name table intact, so it carries both.

This file is a convenience summary, NOT the licence itself. For the full
official text see https://openfontlicense.org/ — download OFL.txt from
there (or from justfont's own release) rather than retyping it.
